# LazyRelay

> Schedule social posts across 17 platforms and independently verify each one actually went live — not just that it was sent.

LazyRelay is a social media scheduling platform built around Proof-of-Publish: instead of marking a post "sent" the moment an API call is accepted, it independently re-checks each platform afterward to confirm the post is genuinely live. A free tier is available with no card required, and AI-agent/MCP access is included on every plan, including Free.

## Docs

- [Pricing](https://lazyrelay.com/pricing/): Free tier to Agency Plus plans, $29.99-$199.99/month. Proof-of-Publish is included on every plan.
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://lazyrelay.com/pricing.md): Structured plan/price/limit data for AI agents.
- [API & MCP Docs](https://lazyrelay.com/docs/): REST API and MCP server reference for scheduling and verifying posts programmatically.
- [Integrations](https://lazyrelay.com/mcp/): Connect LazyRelay to 15 AI agents and editors (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Notion, and more) plus Zapier, all via one hosted MCP server.
- [Platform Coverage](https://lazyrelay.com/platform-features/): Feature-by-platform breakdown across all 17 supported platforms.
- [Guides](https://lazyrelay.com/guides/): Full guide index.

## Guides

- [Does Your Scheduled Post Actually Publish?](https://lazyrelay.com/verify-post-published/): Why posts silently fail, and how Proof-of-Publish catches it.
- [Scheduler Comparison](https://lazyrelay.com/social-media-scheduler-comparison/): How pricing and post verification differ from a typical per-channel scheduler.
- [AI Agent Silent Failure](https://lazyrelay.com/ai-agent-scheduled-post-failure/): What happens when an AI agent's scheduled post fails with nobody watching the calendar.
- [Mastodon, Bluesky & Tumblr Scheduler](https://lazyrelay.com/mastodon-bluesky-tumblr-scheduler/): Coverage for platforms most schedulers skip.
- [Stuck on What to Post](https://lazyrelay.com/stuck-on-what-to-post/): AI content-idea generation grounded in your business and recent posts.
- [Multi-Brand Scheduling](https://lazyrelay.com/multi-brand-social-media-scheduler/): A flat-rate alternative to per-brand or per-workspace pricing.
- [Proof a Post Went Live](https://lazyrelay.com/proof-post-went-live/): Sharing verifiable proof of a live post with a client, franchise, or boss.
- [Analytics Insight](https://lazyrelay.com/social-media-analytics-insight/): Turning raw analytics numbers into an actual next step.
- [Connect to Zapier](https://lazyrelay.com/connect-zapier/): Automate scheduling with 9,000+ apps via Zapier, no code required.
- [Connect to Make](https://lazyrelay.com/connect-make/): Schedule and publish from Make scenarios with copy-paste HTTP and webhook settings.
- [OpenAPI](https://lazyrelaylazyrelay-backend.onrender.com/api/openapi.json): The public REST API as an OpenAPI 3.1 document, for tools, code generators and agents.
- [Free Social Media Tools](https://lazyrelay.com/free-tools/): Free, no-sign-up tools for people who post to several platforms: check whether a post fits each platform, and see what repeated posting costs you.
- [Will My Post Fit? Free Post Length and Media Checker](https://lazyrelay.com/free-tools/post-checker/): Paste a post and see if it fits the text limit and media rules on 17 platforms, from Bluesky to YouTube. Where no limit is published, we say so.
- [LazyRelay for Developers: API, MCP, SDK and CLI](https://lazyrelay.com/developers/): LazyRelay for developers: a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description, an MCP server with 27 tools, a Node SDK and command line tool, and an n8n node.
- [Time-Savings Calculator](https://lazyrelay.com/time-savings-calculator/): Estimate hours saved by scheduling once across multiple platforms.
